macro:
#ifdef DBG_ENHANCE
#define MTWF_DBG(pAd, Category, SubCategory, Level, ...)	\
	do {	\
		if (((0x1 << Category) & DebugCategory)	\
			&& (SubCategory & DebugSubCategory[Level][Category]))	\
			mtwf_dbg_prt(pAd,Category,Level,__func__,__LINE__,##__VA_ARGS__);\
	} while (0)
#else
mapping:
#ifdef DBG_ENHANCE
/* Mapping Wi-Fi driver log to syslog level */
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_OFF		pr_crit
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_ERROR	pr_err
#if (LINUX_VERSION_CODE <= KERNEL_VERSION(5, 4, 0))
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_WARN		pr_warning
#else /* pr_warning is deprecated since version 5.5 */
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_WARN		pr_warn
#endif /* LINUX_VERSION_CODE <= 5.4.0 */
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_NOTICE	pr_notice
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_INFO		pr_info
#define MTWF_PRINT_DBG_LVL_DEBUG	pr_info
#endif /* DBG_ENHANCE */
